reviewer: Codex visual inspection and gameplay evidence review
findings: Four marching ranks, three enemy silhouettes, player shots and worn bunker silhouettes are readable against the dark field.
Yellow dive-warning rings and descending dive positions are distinct from ordinary formation rows.
Cyan/red player ships, lives and separate runtime scores remain readable in cooperative play; neither ship is an automatic follower.
Default three-wave 1P and 2P real-input browser runs both reach native win; the terminal scene preserves the cleared arena and score.
limits: Admission covers the bundled original formation game and documented options, not arbitrary replacement sprites or invented mechanics.
Three-wave default seed is reachable using observable-state automation; this is not a human balance or difficulty study.
No scrolling terrain, capture/dual-ship mechanic or bullet-hell boss is supplied.
No human balance study, physical CRT overscan/calibration or badge/controller hardware validation.
